prompts.02-plants-atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a production-friendly transparent PNG botanical sprite collection for a cozy pixel-art island game.
Primary request: 24 charming, richly varied individual plant sprites in the hand-crafted 16-bit farming-game spirit of Stardew Valley, all from one coherent game.
Layout: exactly 6 equal columns by 4 equal rows, 24 separate centered sprites. Landscape canvas aspect ratio 3:2. Every sprite fully contained within its own equal invisible rectangular cell, generous transparent gutters of at least 18 percent cell width, align ground bases consistently in each row. No sprite touches another. No drawn grid, no headings, no labels, no numbers, no text. True transparent alpha background throughout every empty space, no white backdrop or fake checkerboard, no decorative panel.
Row 1 left to right: round oak tree with rich green canopy; slender white-trunk birch tree; dark evergreen pine tree; pink blooming cherry tree; round apple tree with small red apples; graceful small willow tree.
Row 2 left to right: blueberry bush with visible blue berries; raspberry bush with red berries; rounded hydrangea bush with lavender flowers; layered fern cluster; tall cattails and reeds; two water-lily pads with one pink bloom and no pond background.
Row 3 left to right: three cheerful sunflowers; white daisy patch with yellow centers; lavender flower clump; coral pink cosmos clump; yellow buttercup clump; blue forget-me-not clump.
Row 4 left to right: red and white spotted mushroom cluster; small golden chanterelle cluster; soft mossy rock with clover; ripe pumpkin plant with green leaves; strawberry plant with red fruit; carrot patch with one visible orange carrot.
Scale: trees large but within cells, flowers and ground plants smaller to preserve believable world proportions. Every object separately readable, interesting silhouettes, lush attractive clusters. No tile bases or chunks of soil underneath; tiny grass tufts at tree roots are fine.
Style: true crisp square-pixel art, visibly blocky pixel clusters, clean stepped edges without anti-aliasing, 3-5 shades per material, selective warm dark outline, three-quarter overhead orthographic RPG view with visible plant fronts. Consistent upper-left sunlight. Unified fresh sage/moss greens, warm caramel trunks, buttery highlights, blush coral pinks and lavender blues, restrained bright accents. Cozy joyful sophisticated botanical art, not emoji, not vector, not 3D, no blur or painterly gradients, no cast shadows outside cells.
prompts.04-islands-atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent PNG terrain collection, four original small island environment sprites for a cozy 16-bit pixel-art desktop world.
Primary request: four gorgeous varied grassy islands in the detailed cozy farming-game aesthetic of Stardew Valley, each a complete self-contained little world with a clear grassy top and gently exposed earthen banks.
Layout: exactly 2 columns by 2 rows on a square canvas, four complete separate large island sprites. Each stays wholly within its quadrant, generous transparent margins and a wide cross-shaped transparent gutter between them. Every island fully visible, no object crosses between quadrants. Real transparent alpha background; no ocean connecting islands, no solid backdrop, no fake checkerboard, no text, no numbers, no frames.
Top left: sunny meadow island, irregular rounded grassy shape with tiny sandy edge, gently curving ochre path, one round apple tree at the back edge, white daisies and yellow flowers in two small peripheral clusters, a warm rock at one side; an inviting open lawn in the center occupies at least 45 percent of the grass surface.
Top right: woodland island, asymmetrical bean-shaped grassy top, one pine and one slim birch grouped along the rear edge, blueberry bushes, tiny red mushrooms, mossy stone and log along a side, short exposed brown earthen cliff; central clearing is at least 45 percent open usable grass.
Bottom left: blossom pond island, softly rounded grassy shape, small pink cherry tree at the back edge, a little teal pond with two lily pads along the left edge, subtle stone stepping path and a tiny fern, a few pink and white flowers along the rim; generous open central grassy area.
Bottom right: little kitchen-garden island, wider oval grassy top, small 2 by 3 vegetable patch of carrots, pumpkins and strawberries on one side, lavender, a few smooth stones and one small fruit tree at the back edge; generous empty lawn in the center.
Shared terrain treatment: green grass rim, warm amber soil and stone cross-sections subtly visible on the front side, delicate small grass tufts and roots. No impossible tall floating rock spires, no buildings, no people or animals, no fences dividing the open spaces, no external cast shadow, no water beyond each island footprint.
Style: beautiful authentic crisp square-pixel art, clean stepped edges, no anti-aliased smoothing, rich carefully clustered foliage, 3 to 5 tones per material, selective warm dark outline. Three-quarter overhead orthographic farming-RPG view, horizontal ground plane with visible tree fronts, avoid exaggerated diamond isometric grids. Consistent upper-left golden daylight. Unified fresh sage and moss green grass, warm caramel and tan soil, buttery highlights, soft blush pink and periwinkle accents. All four have the same camera angle, scale, pixel density and visual vocabulary. Polished inviting game-ready terrain illustrations, no 3D render, no vector, no blur, no painterly brushwork.
prompts.01-island-scene:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: beautiful polished pixel-art game environment key art, wide landscape 3:2 image.
Primary request: An original cozy little nature island in the charming richly hand-crafted pixel-art spirit of Stardew Valley. A lush irregular grassy island surrounded by luminous turquoise water, with a delicate sandy shore, visible warm earthen edges, a tiny brook ending in a short waterfall, rounded stepping stones and a short little wooden footbridge. Keep the island the unmistakable main subject, fully visible with ample water around it.
Scene: a curved footpath connects a sunny flower meadow, a tiny vegetable patch, a quiet pond and a small mixed woodland. Rich varied botanical silhouettes: an apple tree, a cherry blossom tree, a tall pine, a birch, a graceful willow at the pond, round berry bushes, ferns, clover, white daisies, sunflowers, lavender, pink cosmos, mushrooms and water lilies. Clusters and open grassy breathing spaces, beautifully arranged with a clear visual hierarchy, not uniformly cluttered.
Creatures: small readable orange tabby cat sleeping on a warm rock, cream corgi by the footbridge, red squirrel holding an acorn at a tree root, little bluebird perched on a stump, sparrows among flowers, a rabbit in the meadow, a duck with ducklings near the pond, a few butterflies. Cute natural animal anatomy with expressive simple silhouettes; creatures much smaller than trees.
Style/medium: authentic meticulously placed square-pixel 16-bit farming game art, visible consistent pixel grid, clean stepped edges, selective warm dark outlines, 3 to 5 shades per material, crisp clustered foliage and subtle pixel dithering. Three-quarter overhead orthographic RPG viewpoint with visible tree fronts and ground planes; no exaggerated isometric diamond. Palette of fresh sage and moss greens, butter yellow sunlight, warm caramel soil, turquoise and teal water, small blush and lavender accents. Gentle light from upper left; calm warm spring afternoon.
Composition: entire island centered, generous clear water margins, rich but readable miniature world, appealing scenic vignette; no buildings or people, no interfaces, no text, no logo, no watermark, no smooth vector shapes, no blur, no 3D render, no painterly brushwork, no photographic texture.
prompts.03-animals-atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: polished transparent PNG animal sprite collection for a cozy nature-island pixel game.
Primary request: 24 adorable different small animals, birds and garden creatures, in one cohesive original hand-crafted 16-bit farming-game style with the warm welcoming feeling of Stardew Valley.
Layout: exactly 6 equal columns by 4 equal rows, 24 individual separate centered sprites; landscape canvas aspect ratio 3:2. Each animal fully contained within its equal invisible cell with generous transparent gutters at least 20 percent of cell width. Keep feet on consistent ground lines within each row. Exactly one individual per cell except the pair of butterflies in the last cell. No overlap, nothing cropped. True transparent alpha background, no white sheet, no checkerboard imitation, no framed cells, no decorative circles, no grid lines, no text, labels or numbers.
Row 1 left to right: orange tabby cat sitting, calico cat standing facing right, black cat with cream chest sitting, fluffy white cat curling up asleep, gray striped cat looking back, Siamese cat with dark ears and paws.
Row 2 left to right: honey-gold floppy-eared puppy, red and cream corgi with short legs and upright ears, cream shiba inu with curled tail, black-and-white border collie sitting, small brown dachshund with long body and short legs, white fluffy spitz puppy.
Row 3 left to right: round brown sparrow, blue songbird with pale belly, robin with orange breast, yellow canary, small white-and-gray cockatiel with yellow crest and orange cheek, mallard duck with emerald green head.
Row 4 left to right: red squirrel holding an acorn with large curved bushy tail, gray squirrel with bushy tail, striped chipmunk, cream rabbit with long upright ears, tiny brown hedgehog with spiky silhouette, one soft yellow and one pale blue butterfly together.
Style: authentic sharp square-pixel art, clean stepped edges, visible consistent pixel grid, purposeful pixel clusters, selective warm dark outlines, about 3-5 shades per animal color, tiny expressive dark eyes with one small highlight. Rounded appealing proportions but recognizable anatomy, cats and dogs have distinct ears and tails, birds have correct wings and beaks, squirrels have thick upturned tails. Three-quarter front/side RPG view compatible with an overhead ground plane. Gentle light from upper left. Warm caramel, amber, muted cream, cocoa and slate neutrals, selective sky blue and coral accents; no clothing or accessories except the acorn. Compact readable game sprite silhouettes with enough detail to show breeds. Animal pixels must be crisp, no soft painting, no 3D, no vector, no glossy emoji, no blurry edges, no extra limbs, no shadows outside the body silhouette.
